name: Aletopelta
sum: Aletopelta is an ankylosaur from the Late Cretaceous Point Loma Formation of California, found in a sewage-pipe ditch.
wsnote: Estimates given in the cited Wikipedia revision.
holotype: SDNHM 33909, with teeth, scapulae, limb bones, vertebrae, ribs and osteoderms — Point Loma Formation, California.
material: Holotype only; it was scavenged by invertebrates and sharks after death.
biology: Quadrupedal armoured herbivore; the carcass formed a small reef.
author: Ford and Kirkland 2001
